title: The Human Chair
synopsis: Ziwen finishes reading the mysterious letter from an anonymous sender…!

fullText.simplified:
不知道是不是我想多了，我觉得最近她越来越喜欢我的椅子了。她会在我的椅子上轻轻地坐下，就像少女坐在恋人的怀抱中一样；她会在我的椅子上睡觉，她睡得那么好，那么放松，就像是睡在最爱的恋人的怀抱中一样。
    于是，我越来越爱她。终于，终于有一天，我有了一个连我自己也不敢相信的愿望！我想：只要能看到我的心上人一眼，和她说说话，就算要我死，我也愿意！
    文文，您应该已经明白了吧？我所说的心上人，其实就是您！自从您先生买下我的椅子后，我这个可怜的人，一直在偷偷地爱着您。
    文文，这是我这一生最大的请求！您能不能见我一面？哪怕说一句话也好？请您同意我的请求吧！
    昨晚为了写这封信，我偷偷跑出了你们的家。因为当面向您开口请求，实在太不礼貌了，我不想这么做。
    现在，当您读到这封信的时候，我正紧张地在您的家附近走来走去。
    如果您愿意答应我的请求，请您走到书房的窗前，把窗打开。看到这个信号，我会装成普通的客人来到您家里。
    文文，我爱你！

    子文看完信，手在发抖。她吓得马上跳下那把椅子，跑到了客厅。即使这样，她还是没有办法平静下来。她完全没有想到，她每天坐的那把椅子，里面竟然藏着一个男人！
    “天啊！太可怕了！”子文小声地叫道。虽然是夏天，但子文觉得全身发冷，手一直在发抖。她不知道应该怎么办。检查椅子？那么可怕的事，她怎么做得了。即使里面已经没有人了，但一定还留着他用过的东西。
    “太太，有您的信！”
    子文跳了起来，回头一看，下人手里拿着一封刚刚送来的信。
    子文无意识地把信接了过来。正要打开，却吓得差点拿不住信。因为她看到，信封上的字和刚才那封可怕的信的字，一样！
    子文在客厅里走来走去，不知道该不该打开这封信。最后，她还是决定打开信，小心地读了起来。这次的来信很短，但信里写的东西，又让她吃了一惊。
    信上说：
    子文老师，突然给您写信，请您不要生气。我很喜欢老师的小说，之前寄的稿子是我写的小说，请老师看后，给我一些意见，非常感谢！因为一些特别的原因，稿子是在我写这封信之前寄出去的，所以想必老师已经看过了，不知道老师喜不喜欢这个故事呢？
    稿子没有标题，是我故意这么做的。我想，给它起名叫《人肉椅子》。
    希望老师喜欢我的小说！
fullText.traditional:
不知道是不是我想多了，我覺得最近她越來越喜歡我的椅子了。她會在我的椅子上輕輕地坐下，就像少女坐在戀人的懷抱中一樣；她會在我的椅子上睡覺，她睡得那麼好，那麼放鬆，就像是睡在最愛的戀人的懷抱中一樣。
    於是，我越來越愛她。終於，終於有一天，我有了一個連我自己也不敢相信的願望！我想：只要能看到我的心上人一眼，和她說說話，就算要我死，我也願意！
    文文，您應該已經明白了吧？我所說的心上人，其實就是您！自從您先生買下我的椅子後，我這個可憐的人，一直在偷偷地愛著您。
    文文，這是我這一生最大的請求！您能不能見我一面？哪怕說一句話也好？請您同意我的請求吧！
    昨晚為了寫這封信，我偷偷跑出了你們的家。因為當面向您開口請求，實在太不禮貌了，我不想這麼做。
    現在，當您讀到這封信的時候，我正緊張地在您的家附近走來走去。
    如果您願意答應我的請求，請您走到書房的窗前，把窗打開。看到這個信號，我會裝成普通的客人來到您家裡。
    文文，我愛你！

    子文看完信，手在發抖。她嚇得馬上跳下那把椅子，跑到了客廳。即使這樣，她還是沒有辦法平靜下來。她完全沒有想到，她每天坐的那把椅子，裡面竟然藏著一個男人！
    “天啊！太可怕了！”子文小聲地叫道。雖然是夏天，但子文覺得全身發冷，手一直在發抖。她不知道應該怎麼辦。檢查椅子？那麼可怕的事，她怎麼做得了。即使裡面已經沒有人了，但一定還留著他用過的東西。
    “太太，有您的信！”
    子文跳了起來，回頭一看，下人手裡拿著一封剛剛送來的信。
    子文無意識地把信接了過來。正要打開，卻嚇得差點拿不住信。因為她看到，信封上的字和剛才那封可怕的信的字，一樣！
    子文在客廳裡走來走去，不知道該不該打開這封信。最後，她還是決定打開信，小心地讀了起來。這次的來信很短，但信裡寫的東西，又讓她吃了一驚。
    信上說：
    子文老師，突然給您寫信，請您不要生氣。我很喜歡老師的小說，之前寄的稿子是我寫的小說，請老師看後，給我一些意見，非常感謝！因為一些特別的原因，稿子是在我寫這封信之前寄出去的，所以想必老師已經看過了，不知道老師喜不喜歡這個故事呢？
    稿子沒有標題，是我故意這麼做的。我想，給它起名叫《人肉椅子》。
    希望老師喜歡我的小說！

sentences.simplified: 子文老师，突然给您写信，请您不要生气。
sentences.traditional: 子文老師，突然給您寫信，請您不要生氣。
sentences.pinyin: zǐ wén lǎo shī tū rán gěi nín xiě xìn qǐng nín bú yào shēng qì

sentences.simplified: 我很喜欢老师的小说，之前寄的稿子是我写的小说，
sentences.traditional: 我很喜歡老師的小說，之前寄的稿子是我寫的小說，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan lǎo shī de xiǎo shuō zhī qián jì de gǎo zi shì wǒ xiě de xiǎo shuō
sentences.english: Teacher Ziwen, please do not be angry that I suddenly wrote this letter.

sentences.simplified: 请老师看后，给我一些意见，非常感谢！
sentences.traditional: 請老師看後，給我一些意見，非常感謝！
sentences.pinyin: qǐng lǎo shī kàn hòu gěi wǒ yì xiē yì jiàn fēi cháng gǎn xiè
sentences.english: I really like your novels. The manuscript that I sent before is a novel that I wrote.

sentences.simplified: 因为一些特别的原因，稿子是在我写这封信之前寄出去的，
sentences.traditional: 因為一些特別的原因，稿子是在我寫這封信之前寄出去的，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi yì xiē tè bié de yuán yīn gǎo zi shì zài wǒ xiě zhè fēng xìn zhī qián jì chū qù de
sentences.english: Please give me some feedback when you have read it. Thank you very much!

sentences.simplified: 所以想必老师已经看过了，不知道老师喜不喜欢这个故事呢？
sentences.traditional: 所以想必老師已經看過了，不知道老師喜不喜歡這個故事呢？
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ xiǎng bì lǎo shī yǐ jīng kàn guò le bù zhī dào lǎo shī xǐ bù xǐ huan zhè ge gù shi ne
sentences.english: Due to some special circumstances, the manuscript was sent to you before I wrote this letter.
So presumably you have already read it. I wonder if you liked my story?

sentences.simplified: 稿子没有标题，是我故意这么做的。
sentences.traditional: 稿子沒有標題，是我故意這麼做的。
sentences.pinyin: gǎo zi méi yǒu biāo tí shì wǒ gù yì zhè me zuò de

sentences.simplified: 我想，给它起名叫《人肉椅子》。
sentences.traditional: 我想，給它起名叫《人肉椅子》。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gěi tā qǐ míng jiào rén ròu yǐ zi
sentences.english: I deliberately did not give it a title.
I’m thinking of calling it “The Human Chair.”

sentences.simplified: 希望老师喜欢我的小说！
sentences.traditional: 希望老師喜歡我的小說！
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng lǎo shī xǐ huan wǒ de xiǎo shuō

sentences.english: I hope that you like my novel.

raw.synopsis: Ziwen finishes reading the mysterious letter from an anonymous sender…!
sentence_translations: I might have been overthinking, but I felt that she had recently come to like my chair more and more.
She would sit gently in my chair, like a young girl sitting in a lover’s embrace.
She would sleep in my chair.
She slept so well and was so relaxed, like she was sleeping in the embrace of her most beloved.
Therefore, I loved her more and more.
Finally, there came a day when I had a desire that I could not even believe myself.
I thought: as long as I could have a single glance at the person in my heart and say something to her, ..
.. I would even be willing to die!
Wenwen, you should have understood by now.
The person in my heart that I am referring to, is actually you!
Ever since your husband bought my chair, I, this pitiful person, have been secretly in love with you.
Wenwen, this is the biggest request of my life!
Can you meet me just once?
Or else, could you say a few words?
Please agree to my request!
Last night, in order to write this letter, I secretly left your home.
Asking you this to your face would be too impolite, so I didn’t want to do it that way.
Right now, as you are reading this letter, I am nervously walking back and forth near your home.
If you are willing to accept my request, please walk over to the window of the study, and open the window.
Once I see that signal, I will pretend to be a regular visitor and arrive at your house.
Wenwen, I love you!
After Ziwen finished reading, her hands were trembling.
She was so scared that she immediately jumped off the chair and ran into the living room.
Even then, she was unable to calm down.
She had no idea that the chair she sat in every day actually concealed a man inside!
“Oh my god! It’s too terrifying!” Ziwen called out in a low voice.
Even though it was summer, Ziwen felt chills down her entire body and her hands were constantly trembling.
She didn’t know what she should do.
Examine the chair?
It was so terrifying, how could she do it?
Even if there wasn’t a person inside anymore, there definitely would be things that he had used left inside.
“Madam, there’s a letter for you!”
Ziwen jumped and turned around. A servant was holding a letter that had just been delivered in her hands.
Ziwen took the letter without thinking.
As she was about to open the letter, she became so terrified that she almost dropped it.
Because she noticed that the writing on the letter and the writing on that awful letter were the same!
Ziwen paced back and forth around the living room, not knowing if she should open the letter.
Finally, she decided to open the letter and read it carefully,
This letter was very short, but what was written inside the letter made her terrified again.
The letter read:
Teacher Ziwen, please do not be angry that I suddenly wrote this letter.
I really like your novels. The manuscript that I sent before is a novel that I wrote.
Please give me some feedback when you have read it. Thank you very much!
Due to some special circumstances, the manuscript was sent to you before I wrote this letter.
So presumably you have already read it. I wonder if you liked my story?
I deliberately did not give it a title.
I’m thinking of calling it “The Human Chair.”
I hope that you like my novel.
